## Summary

Describe the user-facing or operational change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, generated reports, or local SQL are included
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` are updated when configuration changes
- [ ] Public routes include canonical metadata and sitemap updates when applicable

## Risk

Describe effects on authentication, authorization, billing, persistence, API compatibility, SEO, or deployment. Write `None` when none apply.
